positive_cases.name: Direct Core accepted mutation
positive_cases.description: Direct execution of plan_init via transitions.plan_init against TransactionStore with genuine lease succeeds with PLAN_INIT_APPLIED.

positive_cases.name: Unified Ingress same mutation
positive_cases.description: Execution of plan_init via ingress.execute_mutation() with same parameters produces equivalent verified result.

positive_cases.name: Canonical CLI same mutation
positive_cases.description: Execution of plan_init via CLI entrypoint produces identical JSON result envelope with exit code 0.

positive_cases.name: Equivalent semantic result
positive_cases.description: All three entry surfaces produce identical audit, complete identity, and state effects (0 authority delta).

positive_cases.name: Durable external mutation success
positive_cases.description: End-to-end mutation through journal PREPARED->APPLYING, fake GitHub write, readback verify, and journal VERIFIED CAS.

positive_cases.name: Unknown outcome to recovery
positive_cases.description: Transport timeout transitions journal to OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; recovery scanner and executor reconcile state.

positive_cases.name: Fresh authorization retry
positive_cases.description: Retry after RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT requires and consumes fresh CapabilityLease, creating new attempt lineage.

positive_cases.name: Exact successor retirement
positive_cases.description: Retirement of plan with exact successor transitions state to superseded and binds successor reference.

negative_cases.name: CLI semantic authority
negative_cases.description: CLI attempt to bypass ingress or make semantic decisions is rejected.

negative_cases.name: Direct Core authorization bypass
negative_cases.description: Direct Core call without valid CapabilityLease fails closed with AuthorizationMissingError.

negative_cases.name: Unified Ingress lease bypass
negative_cases.description: Ingress call with expired or mismatched lease fails closed.

negative_cases.name: Same key changed authorization replay
negative_cases.description: Reusing idempotency key with modified intent or authorization fails closed with CONFLICT.

negative_cases.name: Generic terminal / Git write
negative_cases.description: Attempts to execute unconstrained terminal or Git write APIs are rejected.

negative_cases.name: Transport success treated VERIFIED without readback
negative_cases.description: Adapter success alone does not commit VERIFIED; readback re-read is strictly required.

negative_cases.name: Journal CAS treated as cross-authority atomicity
negative_cases.description: No claim of atomic transaction across Subject graph and external authority.

negative_cases.name: Retry without fresh authorization
negative_cases.description: Blind retry or reusing old lease on retry is rejected.

negative_cases.name: Heuristic successor selection
negative_cases.description: Retirement without exact successor when multiple exist fails closed with NEEDS_SEMANTIC_CHOICE.

negative_cases.name: Semantic rollback
negative_cases.description: Compensating or automatic rollback of semantic decisions is forbidden.

negative_cases.name: Frozen production storage engine
negative_cases.description: FileBackedDurableJournalStore is not treated as production engine default.

negative_cases.name: M5 runtime / deploy in M4-8
negative_cases.description: Hermes dispatch, runtime activation, and deployment are rejected in M4-8.
